title: Lawn parties, Sam Morgan, and Celestin's trumpet section
summary: Which trumpeters played lawn parties and dances (Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Celestin's second trumpets), and that he only played brass band with Rena.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Everybody be agreeable. Just a second. We're talking about the dance halls and lawn parties and all that, you said you heard Sun Allen and Celestan. That's right. And what about lawn parties? Do you remember who played those? Well Buddy P.T. and Sam, they played those lawn parties. And there's another musician, I'm trying to call his name. No I can't think of his name now. A trumpet player too. Who was Sam? You said Sam played him. Sam Morgan. Yeah, that was a trumpet player too. That was Albert Morgan's brother. They'd play those lawn parties and those different things like that. Sam have a good band? Oh yeah. Yeah, Sam had a nice band. You know any of the fellas in there? No, I was too young, I just mostly knowed Sam. I was interested in the trumpet then and he was a trumpet player and somehow or another looked like that's all I'd mostly be after. Turn this off and turn it on high and lift it. Did any of the bands use two trumpets as dancers? Oh yeah. Celestan used to use two trumpets. Sam Morgan, he used two trumpets. Most all the bands used two trumpets at that time. Do you remember who Celestan's second trumpet was? Well the last second trumpet I noted was Sam Morgan you said? Yeah. No. Do you know who the trumpet with Celestan was, the other one? Was Albert, I can't think of his maiden name, Albert from Over the River. He played second trumpet with Celestan. No I'll figure it out. Yeah. Albert from Over the River. What did he look like? Well he was a light complected fellow. I think I've heard you call his name. That's not the guy that used to play violin that I showed you a picture. No. No he never did play violin. One of the trumpet players I know over there are Charlie Love and Peter Bocash that I can think of offhand, Old Man Allen and Sonny Allen. But you know it'll come to you in a little while. Yeah, yes. I was trying to think. But when you were playing with Renee in the brass band did you have a steady dance job or anything? No I never did play a dance with Renee. No but I mean were you working with anybody else? No. No. You were just playing brass band? That's all. Were you working during the day then? I mean at night? No. No I didn't have any other job. Just playing brass band music and making it that way? Well at that time I was rather young and I didn't have to look for my own support because my people mostly did that for me. Yeah. I'm trying to think of the other trumpet player that was Son Allen. Was Son Allen played second with Celestan? That's right. With Celestan.
